import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
    'ocd_prop_id': str,
    'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',  # Use nullable integer dtype
    'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'prop_name': str,
    'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': str,
    'committee_position': str
})

# Load Source 1
# Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': str,
    'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
    'date_received': str,
    'contributor_lastname': str,
    'contributor_firstname': str,
    'contributor_city': str,
    'contributor_state': str,
    'contributor_zip': str,
    'contributor_employer': str,
    'contributor_occupation': str,
    'contributor_is_self_employed': bool,
    'amount': float
})

# Rename committee_name in df0 to committee_name_x to match target schema
df0 = df0.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_x'})

# Rename committee_name in df1 to committee_name_y to match target schema
df1 = df1.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_y'})

# Join df0 and df1 on calaccess_committee_id
# This is a many-to-many join, so it may produce a large dataframe.
# The join keys are:
#   df0.calaccess_committee_id == df1.calaccess_committee_id
# We keep all columns from both sides, then select/rename columns to match target schema.

df_merged = pd.merge(
    df0,
    df1,
    on='calaccess_committee_id',
    how='inner',
    suffixes=('_x', '_y')
)

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema:
# ['ocd_prop_id': string,
#  'calaccess_prop_id': integer,
#  'ccdc_prop_id': integer,
#  'prop_name': string,
#  'ccdc_committee_id': integer,
#  'calaccess_committee_id': integer,
#  'committee_name_x': string,
#  'committee_position': string,
#  'committee_name_y': string,
#  'calaccess_filing_id': integer,
#  'date_received': string,
#  'contributor_lastname': string,
#  'contributor_firstname': string,
#  'contributor_city': string,
#  'contributor_state': string,
#  'contributor_zip': string,
#  'contributor_employer': string,
#  'contributor_occupation': string,
#  'contributor_is_self_employed': boolean,
#  'amount': float]

# Some columns come from df0, some from df1:
# From df0: ocd_prop_id, calaccess_prop_id, ccdc_prop_id, prop_name, ccdc_committee_id, calaccess_committee_id, committee_name_x, committee_position
# From df1: committee_name_y, calaccess_filing_id, date_received, contributor_lastname, contributor_firstname, contributor_city, contributor_state, contributor_zip, contributor_employer, contributor_occupation, contributor_is_self_employed, amount

# Ensure all columns exist after merge
expected_columns = [
    'ocd_prop_id',
    'calaccess_prop_id',
    'ccdc_prop_id',
    'prop_name',
    'ccdc_committee_id',
    'calaccess_committee_id',
    'committee_name_x',
    'committee_position',
    'committee_name_y',
    'calaccess_filing_id',
    'date_received',
    'contributor_lastname',
    'contributor_firstname',
    'contributor_city',
    'contributor_state',
    'contributor_zip',
    'contributor_employer',
    'contributor_occupation',
    'contributor_is_self_employed',
    'amount'
]

# Select columns in order
df_target = df_merged[expected_columns].copy()

# Fix data types explicitly to match target schema

# ocd_prop_id: string
df_target['ocd_prop_id'] = df_target['ocd_prop_id'].astype(str)

# calaccess_prop_id: integer (nullable)
df_target['calaccess_prop_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['calaccess_prop_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# ccdc_prop_id: integer (nullable)
df_target['ccdc_prop_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['ccdc_prop_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# prop_name: string
df_target['prop_name'] = df_target['prop_name'].astype(str)

# ccdc_committee_id: integer (nullable)
df_target['ccdc_committee_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['ccdc_committee_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# calaccess_committee_id: integer (nullable)
df_target['calaccess_committee_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['calaccess_committee_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# committee_name_x: string
df_target['committee_name_x'] = df_target['committee_name_x'].astype(str)

# committee_position: string
df_target['committee_position'] = df_target['committee_position'].astype(str)

# committee_name_y: string
df_target['committee_name_y'] = df_target['committee_name_y'].astype(str)

# calaccess_filing_id: integer (nullable)
df_target['calaccess_filing_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['calaccess_filing_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# date_received: string (date format assumed YYYY-MM-DD)
df_target['date_received'] = df_target['date_received'].astype(str)

# contributor_lastname: string
df_target['contributor_lastname'] = df_target['contributor_lastname'].astype(str)

# contributor_firstname: string
df_target['contributor_firstname'] = df_target['contributor_firstname'].astype(str)

# contributor_city: string
df_target['contributor_city'] = df_target['contributor_city'].astype(str)

# contributor_state: string
df_target['contributor_state'] = df_target['contributor_state'].astype(str)

# contributor_zip: string
df_target['contributor_zip'] = df_target['contributor_zip'].astype(str)

# contributor_employer: string
df_target['contributor_employer'] = df_target['contributor_employer'].astype(str)

# contributor_occupation: string
df_target['contributor_occupation'] = df_target['contributor_occupation'].astype(str)

# contributor_is_self_employed: boolean
# Sometimes boolean columns can be read as object if there are nulls or mixed types
# Convert to boolean with care
df_target['contributor_is_self_employed'] = df_target['contributor_is_self_employed'].map({True: True, False: False}).fillna(False)

# amount: float
df_target['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['amount'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Export the final dataframe to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_19/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")
